༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa bzhugs so//

lcags mo lug lo zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bdun gyi nub snga sor lha mo'i bla sgrub cig dgos zer bas sems khrid pa 'dra zhig la/ bdag nyid 'bri gung mthil gyi gser khang nang ma yin rgyu ba zhig gi nang du slebs 'dug par gser khang chos rje yin pa'i logs shig na bdag gis phyag mang du btsal ba'i tshe/ des bdag la 'ga' zhig gis yi dam dang chos skyong sogs kyi dbang lung khrid la zab zab mor byed pa mang mod/ de ni ma yin te/ 'dir ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bdag po bla ma yin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon sgrub cing mchod na sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ yi dam/ chos skyong thams cad mchod pa bas kyang bye ba 'bum 'gyur gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par nye'o// zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag gis 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang sems kyi bla ma 'di nyid yin mod// bla ma zhes bya ba logs nas btsal bas mi rnyed par thag chod/ do nub kyi rmi lam yang 'khrul snang yin mod/ 'on kyang gzhan don du 'gyur srid pas/ lam zab bla ma sgrub pa mdo sngags thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa lam gzhan la ltos mi dgos pa zhig zhu lags/ zhes zhus pas/ de yis de ltar rang sems rtogs pa'i zhu ba shin tu bden mod/ 'on kyang snyigs ma'i sems can la phan zhing 'gro don 'byung bas/ lam zab bla ma sgrub tshul 'di lta bu nyams su longs la/ gzhan la'ang ston cig ces gsungs shing smin lam dbang gi chu bo/ phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas/ nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol/ gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho/ de kho na nyid spros bral mthar phyin/ rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba/ rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral/ gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje/ phrin las kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po rnams dbang lung man ngag lag khrid dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gnang ba'i mod la 'di skad gsungs/ kye ma hoḥ

snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi tshe// 'khor 'das bdag po bla ma la// gus pa lhod cing brnyas pa byed// des ni rang rgyud mi grol zhing*// thar pa thob pa ga la srid// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs// smin lam phyi nang gsang ba dang*// yang gsang sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rim// rtsa rlung gegs sel kha bsgyur bcas// ma bu dgus ni zab lam tshang*// 'di las rgyas dang bsdus pa sogs// rang bzo mi bya tshad mar zung*// skal par ldan nges slob ma la// dbang lung khrid dang man ngag bcas// ston tshe gcig gsum lnga bdun dgu// bcu gcig bcu gsum bco lnga dang*// bcu bdun bcu dgu nyer gcig dang*// nyer gsum nyer lnga man chod kyi// zung min slob mar sbyin bya zhing*// de yang dam tshig bsrung ba dang*// bla ma bkur zhing sgrub la brtson// lam 'di thob nas thun bzhi'am// gnyis sam gcig tu mi chag pa'i// dam bca' 'dzin las gzhan rnams la// spel na seṅge'i 'o ma ni// snod ngan blugs ltar chud za'o// lam zab 'di ni mdo sngags kyi// snying po yin no sems la chongs// ngar 'dzin 'dod chen dam mi bsrung*// lam zab thob pas chog sems pa'i// slob ma kha mkhas khrel med la// 'di ni rlung phyogs tsam du'ang min/ khyod kyang sngon gyi smon lam dang*// da lta'i 'phral rkyen gyis bslad pa'i// snying grogs 'ga' yis snying rku zhing*// drin lan ngan gyis 'jal srid kyang*// bla ma sgom zhing rang ngo ltos// bzod pa'i go dang ldan pa'i ngang*// zhi ba'i thabs kyis bzlog bya yi// drag pos mi bya dam tshig yin// dam med slob ma'i grib sel gyis// 'dus byas tshe la tho 'tsham 'byung*// 'on kyang tshe yi bar chad la// bla ma'i tshe sgrub rang byin rlabs| |tshe yi 'du byed brtan par mos// lam zab 'dis smin slob ma ni// skya ser bud med bcas pa'i tshogs// dam tshig gtsang ba 'ga' zung gis// brtan bzhugs rten 'brel sgrig pa sogs// gal che'i dus su nga nyid la// dad pas gsol ba btab pa na// nyams sam rmi lam lung ston 'gyur// de la gang byung 'bad bsgrubs na// tshe yi bar chad nges par sel| |dam med slob ma snying ring la// chos dang zang zing 'brel ba spang*// bshags pa'i thabs la 'bad rtsol gyis// so brgyad zhe dgu la sogs la// nyams grib 'byung ngo yid la zung*| |gzhan yang dgos pa gal che ba// byung tshe lam 'di nyams blang zhing*// nga la gsol ba btab pa na// gang yin lung bstan gsal bor mthong*// lam zab 'di dang 'phrad pa'i mi| |dam gtsang nyams len la 'bad cing*// thugs 'dzin dam bca' ma chag na// skye ba 'di 'og brgyud pa'i tshe// lha mi'i go 'phang ma gtogs pa// ngan song gsum dang lha min dang*| |log pa'i skye ba blangs srid na// dam pa nga yis 'gro rnams bslus// de phyir gces par 'dzin pa dang*// gdams pa 'tsho shes spyad par gyis// des ni bdag gzhan ma lus pa'i| |don gnyis 'grub la tshegs med do// zhes gsungs pa'i mod tshig don la nges pa rnyed par byas nas gnyid las ldang ba'i 'dun pa bgyis ma thag nam langs kyi thun la 'jug ran par snang ba'i tshe/

gong gi tshig don rnams kyang chad lhag med par gsal zhing dag par sems la 'jags pa byung*/ zhes pa'ang 'khrul snang bden bzung dad ldan mgo bo skor phyir 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ lcags lug zla ba lnga pa'i nyer dgu la/ pho brang bkra shis tshugs su mgyogs par bris so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
